run_textual_inversion_sdxl_training: run textual inversion training for Stable Diffusion XL on Intel Gaudi using a folder of images
run_textual_inversion_with_validation: run SDXL textual inversion training with periodic validation image generation and logging
run_textual_inversion_resume_checkpoint: resume SDXL textual inversion training from a saved checkpoint directory
run_textual_inversion_push_hub: run SDXL textual inversion training and push the learned embeddings to the Hugging Face Hub
run_textual_inversion_save_pipeline: run SDXL textual inversion training and save the full pipeline with learned embeddings
